messages.author: 9c5e1e585b3eafe0
messages.subject: Line of histogram
parts:
Hi,

I have an easy question for you, but difficult for me....

I create a data.frame

df8 <- data.frame(x=c(1:439),
First.Y=simple$Join.WithinFirstYear.,
First.Few.Y=simple$Join.WithinFirstFewYears,
Eventually=simple$Join.Eventually)
mdf8 <- melt(df8, id.vars="x")
mdf8$value <- factor(mdf8$value, levels =
c("Definitely no", "Probably no", "Maybe", "Probably yes", "Absolutely
yes"))
mdff8<-na.omit(mdf8)

The dataframe is here: http://dl.dropbox.com/u/4788390/mdff8.txt

Then I plot this histogram:
qplot(value, data=mdff8, geom="histogram", fill=variable,
position="dodge")

I want to adjust a line for each colour

I tried geom="density", but this is not what I want. I need 3 lines,
one for each colour
Also, geom="line", does not work. I take the message "Error: attempt
to apply non-function"

Is there a way to take what I want using this data frame?

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: RE: Line of histogram
parts:
Here are two possible solutions. Is that what you want? If not, be more specific.

mt <- as.data.frame(with(mdff8, table(value, variable)))
ggplot(mt, aes(x = value, y = Freq, colour = variable, group = variable)) + geom_line()

ggplot(mdff8, aes(x = value, colour = variable, group = variable)) + stat_bin(geom = "line", position = "identity")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
